(pholedrine) Profile Pholedrine is a sympathomimetic (p.1407) used in the treatment of hypotensive states. It is usually given orally as the sulfate, of- ten in combination with other drugs, and has also been included in preparations promoted for vascular disorders. Pholedrine eye drops have been used as an alternative to hydroxyamfetamine (p.2322) in the diagnosis of Horner’s syndrome.
